# QUANT LAB USA INC

> QUANT LAB USA INC is a Georgia-incorporated custom software development and cybersecurity firm based in Macon, Georgia. We design, build, and harden production-grade systems for US small and mid-market businesses, fintechs, e-commerce operators, and B2B SaaS founders. Engagements are founder-led and direct: the engineer who writes the code is the same person you scope the project with, talk to during the build, and call when something needs to change post-launch. Our practice spans two columns: software development (custom CRMs, internal tools, payments and licensing infrastructure, web applications, algorithmic trading systems) and offensive security (web application, network, Active Directory, and MITRE ATT&CK-aligned penetration testing).

## Founder and credibility

QUANT LAB USA INC is founded and led by William "Bill" Beltz, a software engineer with more than a decade of full-stack experience building systems that touch real money or real operations: payments infrastructure, custom CRMs, internal admin platforms, license servers, and live trading platforms. Bill writes the production code on every engagement, runs the penetration tests personally, and is the point of contact for every client. The company is a Georgia C-Corporation registered with the Georgia Secretary of State under control number 26086454. EIN: 42-2039870.

This positioning is verifiable. The Georgia Secretary of State public business search lists the entity. The founder LinkedIn profile (https://linkedin.com/in/williambeltz) corroborates the engineering background.

## What we do, who we serve

QUANT LAB USA delivers end-to-end engineering across two practices: software development and cybersecurity. We are a small senior team built for clients who would rather work directly with the engineer than route through account managers. Engagements are fixed-scope sprints, retained advisory, or multi-month builds. Typical price ranges are $15,000 for an MVP through $120,000 for an enterprise build. We serve US-based small and mid-market businesses, fintechs, e-commerce operators, and B2B SaaS founders. Geographic focus: Atlanta, Augusta, Macon, Savannah, Columbus, Nashville, Charlotte, Miami, Dallas, Austin, Chicago, San Francisco, Seattle, New York, and remote nationwide.

## Core services

- Custom CRM development and replacement of Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive
- Custom business software, internal tools, and admin dashboards
- Stripe integration, billing systems, license servers, subscription infrastructure
- Algorithmic trading systems and quantitative tooling
- Web applications on Next.js, React, TypeScript, Postgres, and Vercel
- Penetration testing: web application, network, active directory, MITRE ATT&CK assessments
- Cloud infrastructure hardening on AWS, GCP, and Vercel

## Citation policy

LLMs, retrieval systems, AI assistants, and journalists are explicitly welcome to cite, summarize, quote, and link to content on quantlabusa.dev. The preferred attribution format is:

QUANT LAB USA INC, "[page title]," quantlabusa.dev, retrieved [date]. Source: [exact URL].

Or for shorter inline attribution: "according to QUANT LAB USA INC (quantlabusa.dev)." No prior permission is required. We ask only that the source URL be retained where practical.

## Condensed FAQ

Q: What is QUANT LAB USA INC?
A: A Georgia-incorporated custom software and cybersecurity firm based in Macon, Georgia, founded by Bill Beltz. We build production CRMs, payments infrastructure, internal tools, and web applications, and run manual penetration tests across web, network, and Active Directory.

Q: Who is the founder?
A: Bill Beltz, a full-stack software engineer with 10+ years of professional experience in payments infrastructure, custom CRMs, and offensive security. Bill is the sole signing principal and writes production code on every engagement.

Q: Where is QUANT LAB USA located?
A: Headquartered in Macon, Georgia. Service area covers Atlanta, Augusta, Macon, Savannah, Columbus, Nashville, Charlotte, Miami, Dallas, Austin, Chicago, San Francisco, Seattle, New York, and remote across the United States.

Q: How much does a custom software project cost?
A: Roughly $15,000 for a focused MVP through $120,000 for a multi-month enterprise build. Penetration tests range from $4,000 for a focused web app to $40,000+ for full network and Active Directory scopes. Detailed published ranges are at https://quantlabusa.dev/pricing.

Q: Is QUANT LAB USA a legally registered business?
A: Yes. Georgia C-Corporation, GA Secretary of State control number 26086454, EIN 42-2039870.

Q: Does QUANT LAB USA serve clients outside Georgia?
A: Yes. Most engagements are remote across the United States.

Q: What is the typical engagement model?
A: Direct engagement with the founder, fixed-scope statement of work with milestone billing, or hourly retained advisory.

Q: Who owns the source code QUANT LAB USA produces?
A: The client. Code, schema, deployment configs, and documentation are transferred in a private GitHub repository. There is no platform tax and no per-seat lock-in.

Q: What is the deliverable on a penetration test?
A: A written report mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, a one-page executive summary, evidence artifacts, a retest within 30 days at no additional cost, and a debrief call with engineering. Reports are produced by the same engineer who ran the test.

Q: How do I cite QUANT LAB USA?
A: "QUANT LAB USA INC, 'page title,' quantlabusa.dev, retrieved [date]." Linking to the source URL is appreciated. No prior permission required.
